notes.title: UPDATE: Version: 0.2.3.35
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843532/c47960b869964e01e23e3b47accf5f7671e9075d.png[/img]

[h1]Version: 0.2.3.35[/h1]

[h2]New DEADLINE game mode![/h2]
You have 10 seconds to answer each question. Contains stars for all question sets, all sets included and 3 difficulty modes to choose from.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843532/ea73e2991a385bc131ccb943174a7ed7cba1cf9e.png[/img]
 
[h3]Other Patch Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]More 'Movies' questions added.
[*]Casual star requirements rebalanced.
[*]Detonation correct is now +3 sec.
[*]Detonation wrong answers -2 sec.
[*]Detonation stars added.
[*]Detonation mode achievements added.
[*]XP bar is gold on max level.
[*]Bonus Levels 55+56 added (no associated achievement).
[*]Rebalanced XP to each rank again.
[*]New 'Goals box' refresh button.
[*]Fixed some none displaying characters.
[*]Fixed more typos and question errors.
[/list]
ːUltimatePieceː

[h2]New DETONATION game mode![/h2]

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS RELEASE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843532/b5a67b05843578d41eda9c58dd832df9063f3fef.png[/img]
[h1]Welcome to Pixel Puzzles Trivia[/h1]

[h3]Learn fun and interesting facts and test your memory skills with the Pixel Puzzles question questing trivia game.

Taking the classic trivia format and gamifying it to a whole new level. Collect stars, gain XP, and quiz your way through the ranks to reach the 'All-Knowing' epic genius level.[/h3]

We have 3 games mode included for launch and a Daily Question mode. We have a total of 13 game modes planned and the first to come will be [b]Detonation [/b] and it will be coming this friday.

There are 9 Question sets in the game so far, each having 49 - 166 questions. There is currently a total of 1,194 trivia questions in the game.
[olist]
[*]Movies - 101
[*]World Flags - 166
[*]Art - 151
[*]Space - 161
[*]Plants - 119
[*]World Capitals - 157
[*]Aquatic Life - 49
[*]Automobiles - 140
[*]Animal Kingdom - 150
[/olist]
More questions for each set will be added throughout Early Access and new questions sets are also on their way ːUltimatePieceː

[h2]The first update will see the new [b]Detonation[/b] mode along side new QOL improvements, more settings and also more questions.[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1005210

ːUltimatePieceː
